title: 去 urgent care 看急诊，英语怎么说？
summary: 发烧、扭伤、割伤等不太危急但等不了预约的情况，去 urgent care 这样沟通。

featuredPhrase.en: I need to be seen today.

phrases.en: I need to be seen today.
I have a fever and a sore throat.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, I need to be seen today. I have a high fever.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我今天就得看上医生，我发高烧了。

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.en: Do you have insurance? Please fill out this form.
dialogue.zh: 有保险吗？请填一下这个表。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes. How long is the wait?

dialogue.speaker: Staff
dialogue.zh: 大概 30 分钟，自付费 40 美元。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Fever, headache, and a sore throat since yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 发烧、头疼、嗓子疼，从昨天开始的。

seoTitle: urgent care 看病英语怎么说？美国急诊诊所对话
seoDescription: 发烧扭伤等不及预约就去 urgent care。本文教你全程英语说法，附真实对话，看病不用等。
